distance/height flight times, aircraft launch, long trajectory, pause freeze and clean resume
touch reticle aim, friendly warning and touch hints; no synthetic hover labels
real simultaneous drag/fire, slide-out, no re-arm and touch cancellation
complete forgiving: all 24 threats cleared (22 player + 2 defenders), every friendly survives, zero friendly fire; retry restores 30 heavy rounds
